decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records the added NFT display location for the mint-number referral code, so no additional or edited Event is required.
Making the mint-number referral code visible in NFT metadata does not change badge award conditions or milestone thresholds.
Referral-code visibility in NFT metadata does not change the badge set, badge icons, or badge presentation rules.
The same-message FAQ MODIFY already records that the referral code is shown on the NFT and in NFT metadata, so no additional propagation is needed.
The source retains optional confirmation-email visibility but does not change the email requirement or its contents.
Displaying the mint-number referral code in NFT metadata does not change the reward behavior for mints made without a referral code.
Referral-code visibility does not alter the mint price, founder share, referral commission, or prize-pool allocation.
The metadata visibility change does not affect the required flat secondary-sale royalty.
Showing the referral code in NFT metadata does not alter which sales fund prize pools or how long funding continues.
Referral-code metadata visibility does not change ticket weighting, winner eligibility, or Chainlink VRF selection.
The metadata change does not affect Transak, supported payment methods, or wallet requirements for fiat minting.
Making the mint-number referral code visible does not change which NFT ebook is delivered by the mint.
